name: Ryuubi Gentoku
source:
One of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Koihime†Musou series and first introduced in Shin Koihime†Musou, she is the young queen of Shoku Kingdom. Being quite young she is naive, often reluctant to go to war, and hates paperwork (much to the chagrin of [url=/c217]Kan'u[/url] who as a result often scolds the young queen and reminds her of her duties), but has a lot of confidence on her subordinates. She falls in love with [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url], causing Kan'u to feel a bit of jealousy.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters#Ry.C5.ABbi]Wikipedia[/url]]
